# eslint-plugin-react-a11y

Guide for AI coding assistants using this plugin in a project. To change the plugin's own source, read https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/blob/main/AGENTS.md instead.

> ESLint React a11y rules for React accessibility — WCAG 2.1 rules for ARIA, alt text, keyboard interaction, and focus management, with auto-fixes.

## Enable it

```bash
npm install --save-dev eslint-plugin-react-a11y
```

Requires ESLint ^8.40.0 || ^9.0.0 || ^10.0.0 and Node >=22.13.0.

Flat config files (`eslint.config.*`) are found by ESLint 8.57 and newer; on ESLint 9 and 10 they are the default.

These presets do not turn on JSX parsing. For `.jsx` files add `languageOptions: { parserOptions: { ecmaFeatures: { jsx: true } } }` to a config entry; `.tsx` files are covered by `typescript-eslint`.

```js
// eslint.config.mjs
import reactA11y from 'eslint-plugin-react-a11y';

export default [reactA11y.configs.recommended];
```

Each preset is one flat config object: put it in the array as an element, do not spread it. Rule ids are prefixed `react-a11y/`. Add it to the config you already have; do not remove other plugins. TypeScript files need a TypeScript parser in the config (`typescript-eslint`).

## Presets

| Preset        | Rules | Errors | Warnings |
| ------------- | ----- | ------ | -------- |
| `flagship`    | 1     | 1      | 0        |
| `recommended` | 37    | 17     | 20       |
| `strict`      | 37    | 37     | 0        |
| `wcag-a`      | 16    | 16     | 0        |
| `wcag-aa`     | 24    | 24     | 0        |

### `flagship`

1 rule:

- `alt-text` (error): Enforce alt text on images with accessibility impact context.

### `recommended`

37 rules:

- `alt-text` (error): Enforce alt text on images with accessibility impact context.
- `anchor-has-content` (error): Enforce that anchors have content.
- `aria-props` (error): Enforce that ARIA attributes are valid.
- `aria-role` (error): Enforce that elements with ARIA roles have valid values.
- `aria-unsupported-elements` (error): Enforce that elements that don't support ARIA roles, states, and properties do not contain them.
- `role-has-required-aria-props` (error): Enforce that elements with ARIA roles have all required ARIA attributes.
- `role-supports-aria-props` (error): Enforce that elements with roles contain only supported ARIA properties.
- `html-has-lang` (error): Enforce that html element has lang attribute.
- `lang` (error): Enforce that lang attribute has a valid value.
- `heading-has-content` (error): Enforce that headings have content.
- `iframe-has-title` (error): Enforce that iframes have a title attribute.
- `no-distracting-elements` (error): Enforce that distracting elements are not used.
- `scope` (error): Enforce that scope prop is only used on th elements.
- `no-aria-hidden-on-focusable` (error): Enforce that aria-hidden="true" is not used on focusable elements.
- `click-events-have-key-events` (error): Enforce that onClick is accompanied by keyboard events.
- `no-keyboard-inaccessible-elements` (error): Detects clickable divs without keyboard support.
- `interactive-supports-focus` (error): Enforce that elements with interactive handlers are focusable.
- `no-noninteractive-element-interactions` (warn): Enforce that non-interactive elements don't have interactive handlers.
- `no-static-element-interactions` (warn): Enforce that static elements don't have interactive handlers.
- `anchor-is-valid` (warn): Enforce that anchors are valid, navigable elements.
- `anchor-ambiguous-text` (warn): Enforce that anchor text is not ambiguous.
- `autocomplete-valid` (warn): Enforce that autocomplete attribute has valid value.
- `control-has-associated-label` (warn): Enforce that controls (interactive elements) have associated labels.
- `label-has-associated-control` (warn): Enforce that labels have accessible controls.
- `media-has-caption` (warn): Enforce that media elements have captions.
- `mouse-events-have-key-events` (warn): Enforce that onMouseOver/onMouseOut are accompanied by onFocus/onBlur.
- `no-access-key` (warn): Enforce that accessKey attribute is not used.
- `no-autofocus` (warn): Enforce that autoFocus prop is not used on elements.
- `no-redundant-roles` (warn): Enforce that explicit roles don't repeat implicit roles.
- `tabindex-no-positive` (warn): Enforce that tabIndex is not positive.
- `aria-activedescendant-has-tabindex` (warn): Enforce that elements with aria-activedescendant have proper tabindex.
- `img-redundant-alt` (warn): Enforce img alt attribute does not contain redundant words.
- `no-missing-aria-labels` (warn): Detects elements missing ARIA labels.
- `prefer-tag-over-role` (warn): Enforce semantic DOM elements over ARIA role properties.
- `no-interactive-element-to-noninteractive-role` (warn): Enforce that interactive elements don't have non-interactive ARIA roles.
- `no-noninteractive-element-to-interactive-role` (warn): Enforce that non-interactive elements don't have interactive ARIA roles.
- `no-noninteractive-tabindex` (warn): Enforce that non-interactive elements do not have tabindex.

### `strict`

Same rules as `recommended`.

### Rules in no preset

Enable these by name (`'react-a11y/<rule>': 'error'`); README.md describes each: `accessible-emoji`, `label-has-for`, `no-onchange`.
